review_scope: Independent source review, existing mocked backend tests and harmless interpreter-flags probe only. Reviewer did not execute the fixture, qualification harness, native process APIs, stage subprocesses or WSL.

standalone_controls: Windows cancelled target with its descendants
Independent Windows sentinel released only after target cancellation and settlement receipt
single_chain: Windows synthetic contextual JSON stage completes
Named WSL synthetic stage receives cancellation after both child and new-session grandchild are ready
admitted_attempt.failure_policy: Stop after any failed case or admission. No retry, replacement case, GPU follow-on or distro termination.

corrections_reviewed: Fixture and qualification JSON publish only after exclusive staging-file fsync and no-overwrite hardlink publication; readers no longer treat a partly written final filename as readiness.
Fixture waits for both child-ready and grandchild-ready before reading descendant identity and publishing leader readiness.
Sentinel is explicitly released after target cancellation settles and is rejected if it exits early, so isolation is observed across the cancellation itself.
All isolated interpreter launches explicitly pass -B with -I/-S. -I ignores PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE, so the environment setting alone was insufficient.
Daemon stdin readers use raw input, avoiding a held BufferedReader lock at interpreter shutdown.
On outer resource/deadline failure, an attempt-SHA-bound atomic cancellation marker sets active events and gives owned stage supervisors an eight-second settlement grace.
Any outer forced containment records Linux settlement as UNVERIFIED and classification BLOCKED; empty Windows Job never authenticates Linux cleanup.
Linux live broker-anchored ancestry/pidfd signalling, native host-heartbeat watchdog and independent bootstrap transport exits remain enforced as documented in the backend review.
fresh_prelaunch_requirements: Executor compares all reviewed hashes above immediately before the single invocation; any mismatch invalidates this admission.
Approved base and isolated branch checks pass; original tracked sources and preserved historical inputs remain unchanged.
Private cpu-once leaf does not exist; initial actual Windows RAM and destination free space pass unchanged floors before the exclusive attempt marker.
Named Modly-AMD-Ubuntu-24.04 uses existing modly UID1000 and /usr/bin/python3 only; broker capability/session/identity admission passes before START.

Every case requires natural Windows settlement; WSL case additionally requires the same ready broker/leader/boot identity, ECHILD, complete reaping, empty postscan and contextual cancellation acknowledgement.
Actual failure, forced containment or unverified settlement remains BLOCKED with no subsequent dispatch.
limits: This is pre-execution admission, not a measured OS-lifecycle PASS. Actual receipts, process identities, peak memory, resources, descendant reaping and source preservation must be reviewed after the one attempt.
Linux memory protection is inherited per-process 6GiB RLIMIT_AS plus sampled aggregate RSS, not an atomic aggregate cgroup cap. Windows Job caps do not cap Linux memory.
Natural cooperative cancellation does not qualify forced real pidfd signalling. Mock contracts cover that source path; the fixture does not intentionally force it.
No Torch/model/GPU import, native neural operation, original GLB read, image preprocessing inference, generated completion or public AMD producer is authorized by this CPU test.
